# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 - Architecture and DNA
This project uses Next.js 16+ App Router, React 19.2+, TypeScript 5.5+ Strict, and Tailwind CSS v4.
All components follow the Swiss High-End Light Mode Design Doctrine (OKLCH Color Space).

See `.jules/revolution-plan.json` and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` for the full audit.
